name: UpdateReservationData
description: UpdateReservationData schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

capacity.description: The capacity (people count) of the reservation.

areaId.description: The id of the area this reservation should be in. Optional.

dateTime.description: The date the review created on. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

extraInfo.description: Additional text information about the reservation. Pass empty string to remove it.
